propositions: Mixed-provider fallback chains disable prompt caching because provider-specific cache keys do not intersect across candidates.
The capability record for a fallback chain is the conservative intersection of candidate capabilities, collapsing disagreeing prompt_cache_style values to 'none'.
An operator observing zero cache_read_tokens and cache_write_tokens on a chain-backed op may incorrectly conclude caching regressed when the same model called alone caches normally.
The docs/llm-framework.md accounting section lacks documentation of this fallback-chain caching behavior, leaving operators without explanation for legitimate 0/0 cache readings.
runner_support._intersect_capabilities is the authoritative implementation of capability intersection logic that disables caching in mixed-provider chains.
